repos.description: Penpot: The open-source design platform for Product teams that need scalable collaboration.
repos.summary_zh: Penpot 是开源的设计协作工具，支持设计师创建交互式原型与设计系统，开发者可直接获取生产就绪代码。基于 SVG/CSS 等开放标准实现设计与代码无缝衔接，2.0 版本新增 CSS Grid 布局、设计令牌和组件系统，显著提升产研协作效率。支持浏览器访问或自托管，适用于产品设计全流程。
repos.summary_en: Penpot is an open-source design collaboration tool enabling designers to create interactive prototypes and design systems while providing developers with production-ready code. Built on open standards like SVG and CSS, it bridges design and development seamlessly. The 2.0 release introduces CSS Grid layout, native design tokens, and a new components system, significantly enhancing cross-functional team collaboration. Available as a web app or self-hosted solution for end-to-end product design workflows.

repos.description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.
repos.summary_zh: QwenPaw是自主可控的个人AI助手，支持本地或云端部署确保数据隐私。提供日程管理、PDF/Office文档处理、新闻摘要等内置技能，支持自定义扩展。具备多智能体协作能力，可创建独立代理处理不同任务。跨平台连接多种聊天应用，技能决定功能边界，无供应商锁定风险。
repos.summary_en: QwenPaw is a personal AI assistant under your control, deployable locally or in the cloud to ensure data privacy. It features built-in skills including scheduling, PDF/Office document processing, and news digests, with support for custom extensions. Enables multi-agent collaboration by creating independent agents for different tasks. Connects across multiple chat platforms with extensible capabilities and no vendor lock-in.

repos.description: Nuclei is a fast, customizable vulnerability scanner powered by the global security community and built on a simple YAML-based DSL, enabling collaboration to tackle trending vulnerabilities on the internet. It helps you find vulnerabilities in your applications, APIs, networks, DNS, and cloud configurations.
repos.summary_zh: Nuclei是基于YAML模板的高性能漏洞扫描器，由全球安全社区驱动。支持自定义真实场景检测，覆盖应用、API、网络、DNS及云配置，通过模拟步骤实现零误报，超快并行扫描并易于集成CI/CD，快速应对新兴漏洞。
repos.summary_en: Nuclei is a high-performance vulnerability scanner powered by YAML templates and the global security community. It enables custom real-world detection with zero false positives, supports multi-protocol scanning of apps, APIs, networks, DNS and cloud configs, and integrates seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines.

repos.description: An LLM-powered knowledge curation system that researches a topic and generates a full-length report with citations.
repos.summary_zh: STORM是斯坦福开发的LLM驱动知识整理系统，通过两阶段流程自动生成带引用的维基百科式长文。其核心技术是多视角提问机制，引导LLM提出深度研究问题，结合互联网检索与向量搜索构建知识大纲，再生成完整报告。Co-STORM扩展支持人机协作，已服务超7万用户，支持GPT-4o等模型及Bing/You.com检索，提供Python包与Streamlit界面。
repos.summary_en: STORM is a Stanford-developed LLM-powered knowledge curation system that automatically generates full-length, cited Wikipedia-style articles through a two-stage pipeline. Its core innovation is perspective-guided question asking that enables deep research, combined with internet retrieval and vector search to build topic outlines before article generation. The enhanced Co-STORM supports human-AI collaboration. Serving over 70,000 users, it integrates GPT-4o, Bing/You.com search, and offers a Python package with Streamlit UI for research assistance and knowledge exploration.

repos.description: Chinese copywriting guidelines for better written communication／中文文案排版指北
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供全面的中文文案排版规范，系统性地统一中英文、数字间的空格规则，规范标点符号使用、全半角字符标准，以及专有名词正确大小写。旨在降低团队协作沟通成本，提升内容质量和网站专业气质。包含丰富实用示例和争议性案例讨论，并集成pangu.js等自动化工具实现规则检查。适用于网站、文档、UI界面等所有中文内容创作场景，是开发者、设计师和内容创作者的标准化必备参考指南。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides comprehensive Chinese copywriting and typesetting guidelines, standardizing spacing between Chinese/English characters and numbers, proper punctuation usage, and correct capitalization. It aims to reduce team communication costs and enhance content quality. Includes practical examples, controversial edge cases, and integrates automation tools like pangu.js for rule enforcement. Essential for developers, designers, and content creators working with Chinese language content across websites, documentation, and UI interfaces.

repos.description: Plan, run and supervise fleets of agents from task to merged PR. Desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux) + iPhone & Android apps.  Supports Claude Code, Codex & 35+ coding agents.
repos.summary_zh: Agent Orchestrator 是一款跨平台桌面应用，用于统一编排和监督多个编码 AI 智能体（支持 Claude Code、Codex 等 25+ 工具）。每个任务独立分配智能体、隔离工作区和 Git 分支，通过实时看板追踪 PR、CI 和评审全流程，实现从规划到合并的自动化协作开发。
repos.summary_en: Agent Orchestrator is a cross-platform desktop workspace for orchestrating and supervising teams of coding AI agents from planning to merge. It supports 25+ agent harnesses including Claude Code and Codex. Each task gets its own agent, isolated workspace, and dedicated Git branch. A live Kanban board tracks workers, pull requests, CI runs, and code reviews in real time. A local daemon monitors agent activity and source-control state, providing a unified project view instead of disconnected terminals and branches. It enables efficient parallel development across multiple coding agents.

repos.summary_zh: FMHY 是一个社区驱动的免费资源聚合平台，汇集互联网海量免费资源链接索引。项目采用 GitHub 协作模式，提供网站、JSON API 和 Markdown 多格式访问，支持实时更新与备份。核心价值在于为开发者、研究人员和普通用户提供一站式免费资源发现服务，通过开放协作机制确保资源时效性与多样性，是数字资源领域的'开源目录'典范。
repos.summary_en: FMHY is a community-driven free resources aggregation platform that indexes vast free content across the internet. Leveraging GitHub collaboration, it offers multi-format access via website, JSON API, and Markdown exports with real-time updates and backups. The project serves as a one-stop discovery hub for developers, researchers, and general users seeking free tools and media. Its open contribution model ensures resource diversity and timeliness, establishing a paradigm of 'open-source directory' in digital resources.

repos.description: 📃 A better UX for chat, writing content, and coding with LLMs.
repos.summary_zh: Open Canvas 是 LangChain 开源的 AI 文档协作平台，基于 LangGraph 构建多智能体系统。核心亮点包括：内置反思智能体实现跨会话记忆，支持从现有文档开始而非强制聊天，提供可定制快捷操作和版本回溯，同时支持代码与 Markdown 实时渲染编辑。作为 OpenAI Canvas 的开源替代方案，它通过持久化用户风格规则实现个性化体验，适用于写作、编程等场景。
repos.summary_en: Open Canvas is LangChain's open-source AI document collaboration platform built on LangGraph multi-agent architecture. Key innovations include: built-in reflection agents with cross-session memory, starting from existing documents instead of chat-only, customizable quick actions, artifact versioning, and live code/Markdown editing. As an open alternative to OpenAI Canvas, it personalizes experiences by persisting user style rules and insights, ideal for writing, coding, and collaborative content creation.

repos.description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
repos.summary_zh: Codeg 是多智能体 AI 编程协作工作区，统一聚合 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build 等十余种 AI 编码代理，支持跨代理会话迁移与 @ 委派协作，提供桌面端、自托管服务器、Docker 及移动端全平台部署，让多个 AI 代理在同一结构化界面中协同完成开发任务。
repos.summary_en: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace that unifies 15+ AI coding agents—Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, and more—into a single structured conversation interface with live diffs and project file browsing. It supports cross-agent session import, search, and transfer, plus @-delegation for inter-agent task collaboration in isolated worktrees. Deployable as a desktop app, self-hosted server, Docker container, or mobile apps for iOS and Android, with integrations for Telegram, Lark, and WeChat for remote access.

repos.description: A multi-agent system that keeps running for ~100 hours and solve a very complicated coding or math problem that can be verified
repos.summary_zh: Goal-Driven是一个多智能体协作框架，通过主从智能体架构实现复杂问题的持续求解。系统以明确目标和严格标准驱动子智能体长时间工作（30-300小时），自动评估进度直至达标。已成功应用于编译器、数据库等系统级项目开发，如C++实现TypeScript编译器（100小时）和Rust实现SQLite（30小时），显著扩展了AI解决复杂工程问题的能力边界。
repos.summary_en: Goal-Driven is a multi-agent collaboration framework designed for solving highly complex, verifiable problems through sustained continuous effort. It employs a master-slave architecture where the master agent monitors sub-agent progress against predefined goals and criteria, maintaining persistent work cycles for 30-300 hours until success conditions are satisfied. The system has demonstrated remarkable capabilities in system-level development, including building a C++ TypeScript compiler from scratch in 100 hours and a Rust-based SQLite implementation in 30 hours. By automating long-horizon software engineering tasks, it pushes the boundaries of AI-driven complex problem solving.

repos.summary_zh: MediCareAI-Agent 是一个多Agent自主医疗协作系统，采用患者驱动+AI辅助+医生验证模式。系统通过多路径RAG和外部知识分析实现智能诊断与个性化治疗规划，支持主动康复监测和异常告警。技术栈基于Python 3.12+FastAPI异步后端与React 19前端，兼容多LLM提供商，集成pgvector向量数据库，提供完整的医疗级生产部署方案。
repos.summary_en: MediCareAI-Agent is a multi-agent autonomous medical collaboration system that reimagines healthcare through patient-driven, AI-assisted, and doctor-validated workflows. It enables intelligent diagnosis via multi-path RAG, personalized treatment planning, proactive rehabilitation monitoring, and seamless doctor collaboration. Built on Python 3.12+FastAPI async backend and React 19 frontend, it supports multiple LLM providers, integrates pgvector for medical knowledge retrieval, and delivers production-ready deployment with Docker.
